Hello! I would love it if you could draw my OCs Arsen (red hair) and Lauré (pink hair).

Please draw at least up to their thighs, such as this composition https://skeb.jp/@poi_poifu/works/16. 
Please draw *these* outfits specifically:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/18WPM594p7L-hZMY2FrMFohlF3HXVkKf6/view?usp=drivesdk

They are a couple with an age gap who were originally coworkers/detectives. Arsen is in his 30s and Lauré is 22. Arsen was Laure’s boss. He is easy going, disorganised and a relentlessly inappropriate flirt, but very suave and charming. Please draw a more masculine build & don’t forget the subtle lines of stubble on his chin.

Lauré is a “tsukkomi” type character who is very blunt and strict with him. He is earnest and kind, with a strong sense of responsibility, but can still get charmed against his will and caught up in Arsen’s charisma.  a feeling like ->（ーー//); 💢
